privileged_info_for_vlm: The track gauge is 1.2 meters. The expected height of the loop for this specific coaster (Revolution) is approximately 27.43 meters (90 feet), though any value between 15m and 60m is physically plausible. The curve must be defined using Fresnel integrals: x = integral(cos(t^2)) and y = integral(sin(t^2)). The final file must be named 'coaster_reconstruction.ggb' and saved in '~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/'.
